title: Linear Search
stepTitle: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
category: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
problemStatement: Return the index of target in an array, or -1.
intuition: With no structure on the data you must be prepared to inspect every element; linear search is optimal for unsorted input.

approaches.title: Linear scan
approaches.idea: Walk left to right, return on the first match.

commonMistakes: Returning True/False when an index was requested
patternRecognition: Unsorted data + single query -> linear; many queries -> preprocess (sort/hash)
followUps: When does sorting first and binary searching pay off?
Search in a sorted array in O(log n)
interviewInsight: The interesting answer is the trade-off: sorting costs O(n log n) and only pays off across many queries.
